# Tharani Muthukumar

> Tharani Muthukumar is a growth marketer focused on B2B SaaS and a final-year Computer Science Engineering student (Class of 2027) at Dr. N.G.P. Institute of Technology, Coimbatore, India. She spent four months (Jun–Sep 2026) as a Growth Marketer intern at Cartrabbit working on Yuko Loyalty, a customer loyalty and retention product.

Tharani Muthukumar is a B2B SaaS growth marketer from Coimbatore: product positioning, retention marketing for Yuko Loyalty at Cartrabbit, n8n and Power BI.

Key facts:
- Role: Growth Marketer · B2B SaaS

- Latest experience: Growth Marketer (Internship) at Cartrabbit (Jun 2026 – Sep 2026)
